title: Cloudflare: Pricing In AI Growth

beats.text: Cloudflare (NET) sits in the AI application layer, running the edge for AI apps.
A fundamental-value model puts it near $172. The market pays $268, as of July 11.
That's roughly a 56% premium — the price assumes years of AI growth still to come.

footer: Figures as of July 11, 2026 — educational · not financial advice
